choose.when: SELECT COUNT(id) FROM event_record where event_time between to_date(#{beginTime},'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') and to_date(#{endTime},'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
choose.otherwise: SELECT COUNT(id) FROM event_record where event_time between #{beginTime} and #{endTime}

mapper.select:
SELECT door_name doorName, COUNT( id ) num FROM event_record where
event_time between to_date(#{beginTime},'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') and to_date(#{endTime},'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
event_time between #{beginTime} and #{endTime}
GROUP BY door_name ORDER BY num DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT door_name doorName, event_time eventTime, event_name eventName FROM event_record ORDER BY event_time DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT id, door_name doorName, event_time eventTime, event_name eventName, event_id eventId, person_id personId, person_name personName, event_type eventType, event_result eventResult, event_way eventWay, picture_file_id pictureFileId FROM event_record where event_result = 'DO_REFUSE'
and event_time BETWEEN #{ param.beginTime} and #{param.endTime}
and door_name like concat('%',#{param.keyword},'%')
order by event_time desc
mapper.insert:
insert into event_record(id,event_name,event_id,event_time,person_id,person_name,card_no,picture_file_id, door_index_code,door_name,event_type,in_and_out_type,event_result,event_way, tenant,create_by,creator_id,creator_type,create_time,update_by,updater_id,updater_type,update_time,deleted) values
(#{item.id},#{item.eventName},#{item.eventId},#{item.eventTime},#{item.personId},#{item.personName},#{item.cardNo},#{item.pictureFileId}, #{item.doorIndexCode},#{item.doorName},#{item.eventType},#{item.inAndOutType},#{item.eventResult},#{item.eventWay}, #{item.tenant},#{item.createBy},#{item.creatorId},#{item.creatorType},#{item.createTime}, #{item.updateBy},#{item.updaterId},#{item.updaterType},#{item.updateTime},#{item.deleted})
on conflict on constraint door_time_index DO UPDATE set event_name = EXCLUDED.event_name, event_type = EXCLUDED.event_type, event_result = EXCLUDED.event_result, event_way = EXCLUDED.event_way, card_no = EXCLUDED.card_no, picture_file_id = EXCLUDED.picture_file_id, update_time = EXCLUDED.update_time
